projects.project_about: Production AI-powered contact enrichment platform with intelligent provider orchestration, workflow automation, distributed processing, authentication, caching, and scalable REST APIs.
projects.project_tool: Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, Kubernetes
projects.challenge: Coordinate multiple external enrichment providers with async workflows, retries, rate limits, and cost-aware orchestration without sacrificing reliability.
projects.outcome: Shipped two production FastAPI microservices with SQLAlchemy, Redis caching, OAuth2/JWT, Alembic, and cloud-native CI/CD for enterprise GTM intelligence surfaces.

projects.project_about: Machine learning models for UAV air-to-air path loss prediction using terrain, clutter height, and communication parameters with Random Forest, ANN, KNN, and Naive Bayes. Public research code + paper.
projects.challenge: Improve wireless path-loss prediction accuracy for UAV A2A links beyond classical empirical models alone.
projects.outcome: Comparative ML evaluation with feature engineering, visualization, and hybrid modeling aligned to published research.

projects.project_about: PyTorch multilayer perceptron regressing Boston median home values from 13 urban and socio-economic features—ML fundamentals notebook with StandardScaler preprocessing and train/test evaluation (test R² ≈ 0.81).
projects.challenge: Model non-linear relationships between fragmented urban indicators and housing prices.
projects.outcome: Trained a 13→64→32→1 MLP with Adam/MSE; notebook documents loss convergence and R² ≈ 0.81 on held-out data.

projects.project_about: Scalable distributed database platform for hotel management using Django, PostgreSQL, and Azure SQL for secure multi-user operations. Academic / coursework system design project.
projects.challenge: Support secure multi-user hotel operations with efficient relational data management at scale.
projects.outcome: Modular Django architecture with optimized schemas/APIs for maintainability and scalability.
